record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.original_question: When measure isomorphism is restricted to K-automorphisms, is it a Borel equivalence relation, and can it be reduced to an S∞-action?

evidence.quote: Question 1.16 (Newberger). Is measure isomorphism restricted to K-automorphisms a Borel equivalence relation? Can it be reduced to an S∞-action?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a standard non-atomic probability space, and let $\mathrm{Aut}(X,\mu)$ denote the Polish group of invertible measure-preserving transformations of $(X,\mu)$, modulo equality $\mu$-almost everywhere, endowed with the weak topology. A transformation $T \in \mathrm{Aut}(X,\mu)$ is called a $K$-automorphism if there exists a sub-$\sigma$-algebra $\mathcal{K} \subseteq \mathcal{B}$ such that $T\mathcal{K} \supseteq \mathcal{K}$, $\bigvee_{n\geq 0} T^n\mathcal{K} = \mathcal{B}$ (mod $\mu$), and $\bigcap_{n\geq 0} T^{-n}\mathcal{K}$ is the trivial $\sigma$-algebra. Let $K \subseteq \mathrm{Aut}(X,\mu)$ be the set of $K$-automorphisms; it is a Borel subset. Define the measure-isomorphism equivalence relation $\cong$ on $K$ by $S \cong T$ if and only if there exists $\varphi \in \mathrm{Aut}(X,\mu)$ with $\varphi S \varphi^{-1} = T$.

(a) Is the equivalence relation $\cong$ on $K$ a Borel subset of $K \times K$?

(b) Is $\cong\!\upharpoonright\! K$ Borel reducible to an action of $S_\infty$ (the Polish group of permutations of $\mathbb{N}$)? That is, does there exist a Borel function $f: K \to Y$, where $Y$ is a standard Borel $S_\infty$-space, such that $S \cong T$ if and only if $f(S)$ and $f(T)$ lie in the same $S_\infty$-orbit?
artifact.category_tag: Descriptive set theory of measure-preserving transformations
artifact.status_search_result: Anti-classification results of Foreman–Rudolph–Weiss show that measure isomorphism on the full space of ergodic measure-preserving transformations is not Borel, and recent work by Foreman–Gerber and others extends anti-classification phenomena to weakly mixing diffeomorphisms. However, no source located explicitly resolves whether the restriction of measure isomorphism to the class of K-automorphisms is Borel or whether it is reducible to an $S_\infty$-action; the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Anti-classification results for weakly mixing diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: The isomorphism relation as well as the Kakutani equivalence relation of weakly mixing invertible measure-preserving transformations are not Borel sets.
status_evidence.claim: Measure isomorphism on ergodic/weakly mixing transformations is not Borel, but the K-automorphism case is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: The spaces of measure preserving equivalence relations
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of descriptive set theory of measure preserving transformations and equivalence relations.
status_evidence.claim: General references on Borel complexity of conjugacy in Aut(X,mu) do not single out a positive or negative answer for the K-automorphism restriction.
